title: Core Quintet #27
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Vietnamese woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, bold and confident, pure icy-white hair styled in twin-tail, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, matte finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern — a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme magenta-and-gold extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair porcelain skin, two round red yeonji blush circles painted on the cheeks and a small round red gonji dot at the centre of the forehead, clearly defined dark brows, softly lined eyes with bright real catchlights, small vivid red lips, a serene, dignified expression, sultry, bright golden-blonde hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long almond nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Italian Deruta majolica — a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease, dense repeating floral border filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme cobalt-and-ochre platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Turkish woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, bold and confident, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease, dense scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Center woman's footwear: extreme mother-of-pearl extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Hawaiian woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, sultry, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Escher-inspired tessellation — a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, demure and soft, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern — a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme silver platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
